items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday and remains day-to-day per coach Jesse Minter. He left Week 1 early after 5-150-1 but injury not considered serious.
items.why: Hamstring; coach confirms DTD, not practicing Wed
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri practice; possible sit Week 2 vs NO elevates Bateman/Lane/Moore
items.opportunity: If OUT, increased targets/snaps for secondary WRs

items.text: 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling placed on IR (ankle), out at least 4 games. Opens larger role for Deebo Samuel who had 7 targets/6-48-1 + rush in W1.
items.implication: Deebo primary beneficiary with Kittle snap monitoring; strong WR3/flex waiver
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for Deebo vs MIA

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (rib) is day-to-day; HC Harbaugh wants to see how he feels this week before determining Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury after leaving W1 early with chest/rib issue
items.implication: Status up in air; practice participation key
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, Tre Harris or others gain slot/routes

items.text: Matthew Berry highlights Deebo Samuel as a top Week 2 waiver wire target on FFHH after Stribling IR and solid W1 usage (6/7 for 48+TD + rush).
items.why: Stribling IR + W1 production and role expansion in 49ers offense
items.implication: Add in all formats; WR3/flex upside ROS while Stribling out
items.opportunity: Elevated target share and YAC opportunities

items.text: Malik Nabers logged encouraging return: 52% snaps, 71% routes, 31% target share (9 targets) for 6-69 despite limited role post-ACL; emerged healthy.
items.why: Positive first game back with high efficiency on limited snaps
items.implication: Ramp-up expected; WR1 upside if volume increases

items.text: A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain confirmed, expected miss 4-6 weeks. ETR lists Romeo Doubs and DeMario Douglas as primary waiver beneficiaries.
items.implication: Patriots WR depth elevated short-term; Doubs primary target gainer

items.text: ETR Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Sanders; Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Stribling=Deebo.
items.why: Precise mapping of OUT/IR players to available backups
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for immediate opportunity

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach, but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year — scary history.
items.why: Coach Kubiak DTD after trim; Levitan flags prior knee trauma
items.implication: Realistic W2 return but caution on durability; Mayer handcuff elevated if sits
items.opportunity: If plays, immediate TE1 usage; if not, Michael Mayer snaps/routes

items.text: Kenneth Walker III is a FULL GROWN MAN after MNF eruption in Chiefs debut; Berry loves the workhorse usage and production.
items.why: Dominant MNF performance and clear lead role post-trade

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied for top RB Utilization Score (99) in W1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets for 156 scrimmage yards + 2 TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1.
items.why: Elite snap/rush/route/target shares in new scheme

items.text: Ravens WR Ja’Kobi Lane (wrist) also not practicing Wednesday alongside Flowers DNP.
items.implication: If both Flowers/Lane limited, Bateman/Moore see more work
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps for remaining Ravens WRs

items.text: Travis Hunter played only 4 offensive snaps in W1 in specialized package (jet, screens, decoy); never passed LOS on a route. Jags intention for limited offensive role clear despite draft capital.
items.why: Barnwell charting + Levitan analysis of snaps/routes
items.implication: Two-way player but offense not featured; BTJ/Meyers/Parker primary
items.opportunity: Low route share limits fantasy ceiling early

items.text: ETR Rest of Season Top-150 Rankings live after W1 usage/injury learnings; sizable changes based on roles, not overreacting to TD variance. Trade calculator also live.
items.implication: Use for trades/ROS valuation; avoid overreacting to one week

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee) and signed Jaleel McLaughlin. ETR flags Raheim Sanders as beneficiary.
items.implication: Browns backfield shuffle; Sanders or McLaughlin handcuff upside
items.opportunity: Increased carries if Judkins limited or committee expands
